#!/bin/bash
set -e

TARGET=92147634
FILE=/home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/data/swebench_full/swebench_pilot_data.jsonl.gz
JSONL=/home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/data/swebench_full/swebench_pilot_data.jsonl
LOG=/tmp/post_transfer.log

echo "[$(date)] Waiting for transfer to complete..." > $LOG

# Wait for file to reach target size
while true; do
    SIZE=$(stat --format=%s "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    if [ "$SIZE" -ge "$TARGET" ]; then
        echo "[$(date)] Transfer complete: $SIZE bytes" >> $LOG
        break
    fi
    sleep 10
done

# Wait 10 extra seconds for SCP to finalize
sleep 10

# Decompress
echo "[$(date)] Decompressing..." >> $LOG
cd /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/data/swebench_full/
gunzip -f swebench_pilot_data.jsonl.gz
LINES=$(wc -l < swebench_pilot_data.jsonl)
echo "[$(date)] Decompressed: $LINES lines" >> $LOG

# Run split script
echo "[$(date)] Running split script..." >> $LOG
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base
cd /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier
python split_swebench_data.py >> $LOG 2>&1

echo "[$(date)] Split complete!" >> $LOG

# Report results
for f in data/swebench_full/swebench_train.jsonl data/swebench_full/swebench_val.jsonl data/swebench_full/swebench_test.jsonl; do
    if [ -f "$f" ]; then
        echo "[$(date)] $f: $(wc -l < $f) lines" >> $LOG
    else
        echo "[$(date)] $f: NOT FOUND" >> $LOG
    fi
done

echo "ALL_DONE" >> $LOG
SCRIPT

nohup bash /tmp/post_transfer.sh > /dev/null 2>&1 &
echo "PID: $!"
